$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Retry After Errors settings: the acpmux daemon's loop that sends a chat's turn again by itself after a rate limit, a capacity error or a lost connection (cmux-tui/crates/acpmux/src/hub/auto_resume.rs). The daemon reads these keys from the settings file at each retry and checks this file's defaults and ranges in its tests; gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: agentRetry
lists.note: Settings > Agents > Retry After Errors (Lawrence via Leo, 2026-10-28: "should have retry button + configurable timer loop retry"). acpmux's own autoResumeDelaysMs in its config.json, when set, comes before these keys.

rows.name: autoRetryEnabled
rows.note: Off: a failed turn waits for the error card's Retry; acpmux schedules no attempt (autoResumeDelaysMs []).

help.text: When a model is rate limited or out of capacity, or the connection drops, the chat tries again by itself. Retry on the error card always works.

rows.name: autoRetryInterval
rows.note: 0: the daemon's growing waits (10 s, 1 min, 5 min, then 20 min each; auto_resume.rs DEFAULT_DELAYS_MS). Any other value: that many seconds before every attempt. A provider's reset time can make a wait longer.

help.text: How long the chat waits before each try. 0 waits longer after each failed try: 10 seconds, 1 minute, 5 minutes, then 20 minutes.

rows.name: autoRetryAttempts
rows.note: Attempts per failed turn, a chain of daemon restarts included (auto_resume.rs MAX_CONFIGURED_ATTEMPTS is the ceiling).

help.text: How many times the chat tries again before it stops and waits for you.
